::: {.page-lead}
The modules provide a starting point. When you need help applying the guidance to your own research, SMU Libraries is here to support you.
:::

::: {.support-options}
::: {.support-option}
### Ask a question

Contact the Library for help locating resources, using research tools, or identifying the most appropriate next step.

[library@smu.edu.sg](mailto:library@smu.edu.sg)
:::

::: {.support-option}
### Get research support

Connect with Library specialists for more focused guidance related to your topic, discipline or stage of research.

[rds@smu.edu.sg](mailto:rds@smu.edu.sg)
:::

::: {.support-option}
### Use Library services

Visit the SMU Libraries website for databases, collections, facilities and current service information.

[library.smu.edu.sg](https://library.smu.edu.sg)
:::
